glossary.definition: A metric evaluating the operational efficiency of an individual warehouse worker by tracking their specific throughput against standard working hours.
glossary.formula: (Total units Processed by worker / Total Logged work hours)

glossary.definition: An inwarding strategy where vendors ship goods bundled in specific size ratios that can be scanned and processed as a single unit kit to accelerate receiving.
glossary.formula: Kit Quantity = ∑(Ratio of Size A + Ratio of Size B + Ratio of Size C)

glossary.definition: The % of physical goods received at the dock that are successfully verified and systematically added to live inventory within SLA.
glossary.formula: (Total Invoices Systematically GRN'd within SLA / Total Invoices physically received) x 100

glossary.definition: A continuous improvement metric tracking the % of operational inefficiencies identified during leadership floor observations that are successfully resolved.
glossary.formula: (Total Gemba Issues Resolved / Total Gemba Issues Identified) x 100

glossary.definition: Backlog volume of physically unpacked, and sellable inventory lying on the staging floor waiting to be putaway into pick bins.
glossary.formula: Total Sellable Units Unpacked - Total Sellable units Systemically Put Away in Bins

glossary.definition: Backlog volume of defective, missing or blocked inventory on the warehouse floor waiting for vendor return, liquidation or adjustment.
glossary.formula: Total Received Units - (Total Sellable Units + Total Rejected units processed out)

glossary.definition: A North Star metric indicating the % of all assigned B2C & B2B orders successfully manifested by facility.
glossary.formula: (Total orders successfully manifested / Total orders allocated to facility) x 100

glossary.definition: Quantified loss of inventory by internal theft, systemic mismatches, unrecorded damage or fake returns identified during audits.
glossary.formula: ((System Inventory Value - Physical Audited Inventory Value) / System Inventory Value) x 100

glossary.definition: The speed and accuracy at which an item is moved from the inwarding dock and systematically scanned into its final bin.
glossary.formula: (Total Items Put Away within SLA / Total Items GRN'd) x 100

glossary.definition: The capacity efficiency of bulk storage zones dedicated to holding large inventory reserves before consolidation into active picking zones.
glossary.formula: (Total Volume of goods currently in HDR / Total HDR Volumetric Capacity) x 100

glossary.definition: The variance between the digital inbound freight details transmitted by the supplier in the system and the actual physical goods received at the dock.
glossary.formula: (Total ASN Quantities Matching Physical GRN / Total ASN Quantities Submitted) x 100

glossary.definition: Dimensional weight utilized by logistics partners to bill freight for boxes that are large in volume but light in physical dead weight.
glossary.formula: (L x W x H in cm) / Contracted volumetric divisor

glossary.definition: Volumetric efficiency of a dedicated B2B linehaul truck reserved entirely for the brand's inter-facility or store dispatches.
glossary.formula: (Total CFT Volume of Loaded Shipments / Total CFT capacity of Truck) x 100

glossary.definition: Measure of how effectively smaller shipments are grouped together into shared trucks to optimize linehaul freight costs.
glossary.formula: Total Consolidated Shipment Volume / Total PTL Truck Capacity

glossary.definition: The reliability of bulk freight moving between major central nodes before it is broken down for last-mile delivery.
glossary.formula: (Total Linehaul Runs completed within SLA / Total Linehaul Runs Scheduled) x 100

glossary.definition: The compliance rate of retail store dispatches and B2B shipments outwarded seamlessly using RFID tunnels rather than manual barcode scanning.
glossary.formula: (Total EPC units outwarded via RFID / Total units outwarded) x 100

glossary.definition: The precision rate at which retail RFID hardware correctly identifies tags and syncs the exact sale to OMS without ghost reads.
glossary.formula: (Total Accurate RFID Till Invoices / Total Invoices Processed via RFID Till) x 100

glossary.definition: An advanced inventory health metric calculating exactly how many days the current on hand stock will last based on the trailing sales run rate.
glossary.formula: Current Inventory Units / Average Daily Units Sold

glossary.definition: Productivity metric indicating the % of received inbound inventory that has been successfully sold through to end consumers.
glossary.formula: (Total Units Sold / Total Units Received at Warehouse) x 100

glossary.definition: The speed at which incoming bulk shipments are unloaded from an inbound truck and loaded directly onto an outbound truck, bypassing storage.
glossary.formula: (Total Units Cross-Docked / Total Units Received) x 100

glossary.definition: A measure of how efficiently fast-moving SKUs are placed in easily accessible primary pick faces compared to slow moving inventory.
glossary.formula: (Total Picks from Primary Strike Zones / Total Overall Picks) x 100

glossary.definition: The speed and accuracy at which consolidated batches of orders (waves) are collected by pickers before being routed to sorting stations.
glossary.formula: Total Units Picked in Wave / Total Time Taken for wave

glossary.definition: The measure of wasted, unusable space inside a storage bin or rack caused by storing partially depleted pallets or non-stackable SKUs.
glossary.formula: (Total Empty Space in Active Bins / Total Cubic Capacity of Active Bins) x 100

glossary.definition: The % of customer orders that can be completely fulfilled from available stock on hand without backorders or cancellations.
glossary.formula: (Total Orders shipped complete / Total orders placed) x 100

glossary.definition: A strict compounded quality metric tracking orders that are picked accurately, packed securely, manifested on time, and shipped without any defects.
glossary.formula: (% orders on-time) x (% orders complete) x (% orders damage-free) x (% orders accurately documented)

glossary.definition: The % of total available vertical and horizontal warehouse space that is actively occupied by physical inventory.
glossary.formula: (Total cubic volume of stored goods / Total Warehouse cubic storage capacity) x 100

glossary.definition: The total cycle time it takes for an inbound shipment to move from the receiving dock door to being fully available for order allocation in WMS.
glossary.formula: Timestamp of Inventory Live in systems - Timestamp of Truck Unloading

glossary.definition: The average time required to assemble components or pre-packs into a final bundled SKU ready for dispatch.
glossary.formula: Total time Assembling Kits / Total Number of Kits Produced

glossary.definition: Strict compliance metric ensuring a retail store or B2B partner receives exact requested inventory quantities on the scheduled delivery date.
glossary.formula: (Total B2B Shipments Delivered Complete and On Time / Total B2B shipments dispatched) x 100

glossary.definition: The ratio of the actual weight or volume, carried by logistics fleet vehicle compared to its maximum permissible payload capacity.
glossary.formula: (Actual Payload Weight or Volume / Max Vehicle capacity) x 100

glossary.definition: The logistical efficiency of a delivery route, measured by the physical concentration of successful delivery drops within a specific geographic radius.
glossary.formula: Total Number of successful drops / Total Route KMs driven

glossary.definition: The wasted logistical distance and fuel consumed when a dedicated B2B fleet vehicle returns empty after completing all scheduled drops.
glossary.formula: Total KMs driven empty / Total Fleet KMs driven

glossary.definition: The strategic maximizing of the average unit count or volume delivered per stop on a consolidated regional milk route to lower the cost per delivery.
glossary.formula: Total units dispatched on Route / Total number of store drops

glossary.definition: Financial discrepancy occurring when a carrier reclassifies a shipment's freight class during transit, leading to unexpected billing surcharges.
glossary.formula: Actual Billed Freight Cost - System Estimated Freight Cost

glossary.definition: Metric evaluating the courier's routing algorithm in minimizing the distance driven between individual customer drops within a delivery zone.
glossary.formula: Optimal Algorithm Route Distance / Actual KMs driven by driver

glossary.definition: The % of shipments routed directly from the origin warehouse to the destination last-mile hub, completely skipping intermediate sorting facilities.
glossary.formula: (Total shipments bypassing Sort Hubs / Total network shipment) x 100

glossary.definition: A network measure ensuring that contracted 3PL partners are being fed the exact volume of daily shipments they committed to handling without breaching cut-offs.
glossary.formula: (Total shipments handed to carrier / Carrier contracted daily capacity) x 100

glossary.definition: Adherence of a dedicated vehicle loop to its scheduled delivery timeline across multiple retail stores without delays or missed handovers.
glossary.formula: (Total Drops completed on Time) / (Total Scheduled Drops) x 100

glossary.definition: % of orders successfully handed to the end customer on the very first physical attempt.
glossary.formula: (Total Deliveries Succeeded on Attempt 1 / Total deliveries attempted) x 100

glossary.definition: The deviation in pure linehaul transit duration measuring how consistently freight moves between origin processing center and the destination city hub.
glossary.formula: Actual H2H Transit Time - Contracted Lane SLA Time

glossary.definition: The % of national postal codes the brand can actively deliver to based on the combined network reach of all dynamically onboarded courier partners.
glossary.formula: (Serviceable pincodes in order allocation / Total National Pincodes) x 100

glossary.definition: A logistics fraud metric tracking how often a rider marks a delivery as failed or completed while being outside the GPS radius of customer address.
glossary.formula: (Total updates logged outside geofence / Total status Updates) x 100

glossary.definition: % of customer return requests that are successfully picked up, transported, inwarded back at the warehouse without loss in transit.
glossary.formula: (Total returns inwarded / Total return requests) x 100

glossary.definition: Proportion of RTOs that arrive back at the warehouse that can be re-inventoried for sale.
glossary.formula: (RTO marked sellable / Total RTOs received) x 100

glossary.definition: The weight of a shipment relative to its volume, to determine exact freight class and identify instances where packages are shipping too much empty air.
glossary.formula: Total Shipment Weight / Total Shipment Volume

glossary.definition: Total time a vehicle spends idling at the warehouse dispatch dock during the unloading of returns and loading of fresh forward stock.
glossary.formula: Timestamp of Vehicle Gate Out - Timestamp of Vehicle Gate In

glossary.definition: Duration a loaded carrier trailer sits parked in the facility's yard before being dispatched onto the road network.
glossary.formula: Timestamp of Final Dispatch - Timestamp of Trailer Sealing

glossary.definition: Frequency at which last mile driver deviates from system optimized route leading to delayed deliveries and wasted fuel.
glossary.formula: (Total KMs driven off-route / Total planned KMs) x 100

glossary.definition: The ratio of the actual freight weight compared to the maximum legally allowable gross weight of the linehaul vehicle.
glossary.formula: (Actual Freight Weight / Max legal gross vehicle weight allowed) x 100

glossary.definition: Excess freight cost incurred when couriers apply a stricter volumetric divisor for large, lightweight B2B boxes.
glossary.formula: Billed Volumetric Freight Cost - Standard Dead Weight Freight Cost

glossary.definition: Variance between the weight recorded by warehouse dispatch scales vs the weight audited by the courier's hub.
glossary.formula: (Courier Billed Weight - WH Captured Weight) / WH Captured Weight

glossary.definition: The WMS logic efficiency of grouping orders with similar SKUs or destination zones to minimize floor picker travel distance.
glossary.formula: Total Distance Saved via Batching / Total Standard Single-Order Pick Distance

glossary.definition: % of total freight shipped via premium express methods to recover from delays or meet strict commitments.
glossary.formula: (Total Expedited Shipments / Total Shipments) x 100

glossary.definition: Duration to receive a return, execute QC and systemically make it available for resale.
glossary.formula: Timestamp of Inventory Live for Sale - Timestamp of RVP Unloading at Dock

glossary.definition: Financial recovery from washing or refurbishing damaged B2C returns into sellable states.
glossary.formula: (Revenue from Salvaged Stock / Original COGS of damaged stock) x 100

glossary.definition: Metric evaluating the number of days a dispatched shipment sits stagnant in the courier network without tracking updates.
glossary.formula: Current Date - Timestamp of Last Courier Milestone Update

glossary.definition: % of labels generated by the system that are cancelled before handover to the courier.
glossary.formula: (Total cancelled manifests / Total generated manifests) x 100

glossary.definition: Effectiveness of WMS algorithms selecting the smallest possible shipping box to minimize volumetric freight costs.
glossary.formula: (Total Volume of items in Box / Total Volume of selected box) x 100

glossary.definition: Frequency a single multi-item order must be fulfilled from different WHs or separate boxes.
glossary.formula: (Total orders requiring multiple shipments / Total Multi-Item orders) x 100

glossary.definition: The success rate of holding early orders to combine with subsequent orders by the customer, reducing shipping costs.
glossary.formula: (Total shipments consolidated / Total eligible orders placed in time window) x 100

glossary.definition: Evaluates the symmetry of freight moving between regions to ensure trucks aren't running full one way and empty the other.
glossary.formula: Total outbound tonnage on lane / Total inbound tonnage on lane

glossary.definition: % of shipments arriving structurally damaged by the carrier partner.
glossary.formula: (Total Shipments flagged damaged in transit / Total shipments handled) x 100

glossary.definition: % of shipments encountering transit roadblocks like vehicle breakdowns etc.
glossary.formula: (Total shipments logged in exception status / Total dispatched shipments) x 100

glossary.definition: Technical reliability of the API connection between the OMS and the 3PL's tracking system.
glossary.formula: (Total mins API is fully operational / Total minutes in month) x 100

glossary.definition: The success rate of financial claims raised against courier partners for transit losses, fake returns or damages.
glossary.formula: (Approved SPF Claim Value / Total raised SPF Value) x 100

glossary.definition: Cost savings achieved by routing heavy B2B freight directly to a specific city via a dedicated truck.
glossary.formula: Pre-DLA Standard Freight Cost - Current Dedicated Fleet Cost

glossary.definition: % of staged, packed inventory awaiting dispatch physically held on the dock before restricting picking operations.
glossary.formula: Total Staged Pallets / Total Max Dock staging capacity

glossary.definition: % at which air freight shipments are bumped off by airlines due to weight limits.
glossary.formula: (Total shipments offloaded / Total shipments booked for air) x 100

glossary.definition: Rate at which courier partners fraudulently mark a fwd shipment as RTO without making a physical attempt.
glossary.formula: (Total RTOs with zero GPS proof of attempt / Total RTOs initiated) x 100

glossary.definition: Number of days it takes for a courier partner to deposit collected COD funds into the brand's bank account.
glossary.formula: Timestamp of Bank Settlement - Timestamp of Successful COD Delivery

glossary.definition: Measures how frequently the last-mile delivery rider has to physically call the customer to ask for directions or confirm availability before dropping the parcel.
glossary.formula: (Total orders with Rider-to-Customer Calls / Total orders attempted) x 100

glossary.definition: Financial impact including purchase, installation, operation and disposal costs.
glossary.formula: Purchase Price + Acquisition Costs + Operating Costs + Maintenance Costs - Salvage Value

glossary.definition: Share of total inventory that shows zero demand over a specified duration.
glossary.formula: (Value of Non-Moving Inventory / Total Inventory Value) x 100

glossary.definition: Quantity of physical inventory available to complete sales.
glossary.formula: Beginning Inventory Value / Net units sold

glossary.definition: Margin return earned on each unit of inventory over a period.
glossary.formula: Gross Profit / Avg Inventory Cost

glossary.definition: Rate at which the linehaul courier trucks are detained at state borders by authorities causing multi-day delays.
glossary.formula: (Total Shipments Delayed by Border Holds / Total Interstate Shipments) x 100

glossary.definition: Cost to execute an order, including WH labor, packaging materials, facility overhead and shipping.
glossary.formula: Total Fulfillment & Logistics Operational Cost / Total orders shipped

glossary.definition: The error rate where the WMS indicates stock is available in a bin, but physical verification proves it missing.
glossary.formula: (Total units missing during audit / Total system units audited) x 100

glossary.definition: % of inbound shipments arriving without an ASN, forcing manual identification and slowing GRN.
glossary.formula: (Total shipments received without ASN / Total Inbound Shipments) x 100

glossary.definition: % of out-of-stock items placed on backorder that are ultimately canceled by the customer before the stock is replenished.
glossary.formula: (Total Backorders canceled / Total Backorders created) x 100

glossary.definition: Estimated gross revenue lost over a specific period due to high-demand SKUs hitting zero inventory on the storefront.
glossary.formula: Avg Daily Sales of SKU x Days out of stock x Unit selling price

glossary.definition: % of the originally requested procurement quantity that the vendor actually delivers to the warehouse.
glossary.formula: (Total Units Received / Total Units ordered on PO) x 100

glossary.definition: Total time taken for inventory to be physically dispatched from one retail store and systematically received at another.
glossary.formula: Timestamp of Destination Store GRN - Timestamp of Origin Store Dispatch

glossary.definition: Adherence rate of retail stores correctly scanning, documenting and dispatching B2B or customer returns via the mini OMS system.
glossary.formula: (Total Store Dispatches Logged in OMS / Total Physical Store Dispatches) x 100

glossary.definition: Approving, dispatching and inward purchase orders for operational warehouse consumables like corrugated boxes and tape.
glossary.formula: Timestamp of Consumable GRN - Timestamp of NTPO Creation

glossary.definition: WH process of applying new barcodes, MRP tags or market flow specific labels (Myntra SOR) to existing inventory to meet channel compliance before dispatch.
glossary.formula: Total units successfully restickered / Total units requiring new labels

glossary.definition: Operational process of physically attaching RFID tags to Non-RFID enabled inventory and linking the product data to the systemic Electronic Product Code (EPC) to ensure max coverage.
glossary.formula: (Total units successfully encoded with RFID / Total Non-RFID units received) x 100

glossary.definition: The internal movement of inventory across different company branches or facilities, tracked systemically through sale bill APIs.
glossary.formula: (Total IBT Units Successfully Reconciled / Total IBT Units Dispatched) x 100

glossary.definition: A financial document generated in the ERP system to formally account for the inwarded stock after physical warehouse receiving matches Purchase Order.
glossary.formula: Total Inwarded Quantity x Invoiced Unit Price

glossary.definition: An omnichannel capability enabling customers to return e-commerce purchases directly at the physical retail stores.
glossary.formula: (Total Online Orders Returned at Retail POS / Total Online Returns) x 100

glossary.definition: Operational variance identified when physical audit quantities or store inward counts do not match the systemic dispatch documents.
glossary.formula: Total System Quantity Dispatched - Total Physical Quantity Received

glossary.definition: Inventory prioritization method ensuring older orders are processed and dispatched before newer ones to prevent aging and maintain SLA compliance.
glossary.formula: (Total Orders processed in chronological sequence / Total orders processed) x 100

glossary.definition: A consolidated logistics routing model where a dedicated vehicle completes multiple scheduled drops to specific retail or Qcom stores within a tight geographic area.
glossary.formula: (Total number of successful store drops / Total scheduled route stops) x 100

glossary.definition: A continuous, systematic auditing process of counting specific WH bins daily using handheld tool to maintain systemic inventory accuracy and reduce Not Found instances.
glossary.formula: (|Physical Bin count - System Bin Count| / System Bin Count) x 100

glossary.definition: Re-engaging customers and completing a reverse pickup after the courier partner previously logged a failure or rejection reason.
glossary.formula: (Total successful pickups post-NPR / Total NPR cases logged) x 100

glossary.definition: An omnichannel retail feature where a store out of a specific SKU can place an order directly from the central warehouse inventory on behalf of the walk-in customer.
glossary.formula: (Total EA Invoices Generated / Total Retail Store Invoices) x 100

glossary.definition: A logistical alignment ensuring courier partners deploy vehicles multiple times a day to the WH to speed up M2H.
glossary.formula: (Total Executed Multi-Pickups / Total Scheduled Multi-Pickups) x 100

glossary.definition: Orders that fail instantly upon creation due to catalog misalignments, unresolved system sync delays between Shopify and Unicommerce or ghost inventory.
glossary.formula: (Total Direct error orders / Total orders placed) x 100

glossary.definition: A foundational database uploaded by the WH team into the WAM module, linking supplier product codes to internal SKUs to enable seamless scanning and inwarding.
glossary.formula: (Total SKUs with active VIM records / Total procured SKUs) x 100

glossary.definition: A systemic B2B distribution workflow that digitally ties specific outbound box barcodes from the warehouse directly to the receiving retail store's inwarding system.
glossary.formula: (Total boxes successfully mapped to Inward / Total boxes dispatched) x 100
